answer: Reaching the kernel of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A lantern of per-task receipts records who did what, and the vine of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
